subject: Audit log evidence: snapshot schedule & on-demand handoff
messages:
From: Julie Hansen <julie.hansen@acme.health>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.health
Date: Mon, 09 May 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: audit log snapshots and proof of custody for SOC 2 review

Hi Monica / Ben,

As part of our upcoming SOC 2 readiness audit (week of May 24), our auditors have asked for the following: a weekly snapshot of admin activity logs covering root/admin role changes, token issuance/revocation events, and console login trails for the last 90 days, plus a short description of how Redwood exports and hands off evidence (who signs/receives the bundle and how its delivered).

Can you confirm:
- whether you can produce a point-in-time snapshot for May 9 covering the last 90 days,
- the typical TTL/retention for admin activity logs, and
- the export formats you support for secure handoff (S3 presigned, password-protected tar, direct upload to our Evidence Drive).

We prefer S3 presigned links to our vendor intake bucket, but can accept encrypted tar if thats easier operationally. Also please include any checksum/hash we should expect for chain-of-custody.

Thanks,
Julie Hansen
Security Lead, Acme Health
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Julie Hansen <julie.hansen@acme.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit log snapshots and proof of custody for SOC 2 review

Hi Julie,

Thanks for the clear ask — we can support this. Summary below and action items at the end.

What we log (admin activity):
- Console/API admin auth events (login, MFA failures/successes).
- Token lifecycle: creation, refresh, revocation, and associated client id.
- Role and permission changes (RBAC grants/revokes).
- Admin-level configuration changes (network rules, KMS bindings, audit configuration).
- Service account operations that perform admin-level actions.

Retention policy:
- Native retention: 365 days for high-sensitivity admin events (by default), 90 days for standard operational logs.
- For evidence requests we can snapshot full 365-day admin ledger and produce an export bundle on request.

Export formats & handoff options:
- Encrypted tar.gz bundle (AES-256) delivered via secure S3 presigned POST to your intake bucket (preferred for transfer control).
- Direct upload into a shared Evidence Drive folder (Drive link & ACL change log included).
- One-time AWS KMS-wrapped encrypted archives upon request.

Chain-of-custody & checksums:
- Each snapshot bundle includes a SHA-256 manifest (manifest.sha256) and a GPG-signed transfer receipt.
- We record the export action in our operator trail with operator id, timestamp, destination URL, and export artifact checksum.

Action items and timeline:
1) Monica: produce May 9 snapshot (90-day view) and push encrypted tar to your intake S3 by Tue May 11 EOD PT.
2) Priyom: include the manifest.sha256 and the operator trail excerpt in the bundle.
3) Ben: will coordinate DPA / transfer approval if your team needs a specific contract clause.

Attachments: soc2_evidence_matrix_acme.xlsx (matrix mapping logs to SOC 2 controls).

If S3 presigned upload works, share the bucket/name and preferred expiration window (we support up to 72h presigned).

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Julie Hansen <julie.hansen@acme.health>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit log snapshots and proof of custody for SOC 2 review

Hi Julie / Monica,

Snapshot export status:
- Admin ledger snapshot (2027-02-08 -> 2027-05-09) complete.
- Archive created: admin_activity_snapshot_20270509.tar.gz (AES-256 encrypted).
- Manifest and operator trail included: manifest.sha256, operator_export_receipt.txt (GPG-signed).

Delivery plan (as requested):
Option A — S3 presigned to your intake bucket (recommended):
- I will create a presigned POST with 48h expiry and upload the archive. You will get a single-use URL and the checksum.
- Transfer will be logged: export id EX-20270511-007.

Option B — Upload to Evidence Drive:
- We can push the artifact to your shared folder and share a Drive ACL change log (less ideal for automated ingestion).

Please confirm which option you prefer. Security notes:
- We will rotate the transfer key immediately after upload.
- If you need HSM-wrapped encryption (KMS), we can trigger that but it will add ~2h to processing time.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 09:30 AM Julie Hansen <julie.hansen@acme.health> wrote:
> Thanks Priyom — presigned S3 is preferred. Please set expiry to 48h. Can you also include the operator id in the email so our auditors can reconcile?
>
> - Julie
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Julie Hansen <julie.hansen@acme.health>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit log snapshots and proof of custody for SOC 2 review

Julie — quick confirmation and a small ask on timing.

We will proceed with Option A (S3 presigned), 48h expiry. Export ID: EX-20270511-007. Operator: pri_das@redwood (Priyom Das).

Next steps:
- Priyom to upload and send the presigned POST URL + manifest.sha256 by end of day today.
- Monica to add a short transfer note to the SOC 2 evidence binder describing retention and export workflow (one paragraph).
- Julie to confirm once the upload is verified on your side so we can close the ticket.

If Acme needs the artifact notarized or a DocuSign transfer receipt, we can route that through Legal (Ive copied DocuSign notifications if needed).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
